basic_info.description: Just steps from the heart of NOPA, this top-floor 1 bd/1ba condo is a total gem - bright, stylish, & perfectly perched right off the buzzing Divisadero corridor.  Enter into a welcoming lobby with a breezy garden atrium and elevator (yes, your legs will thank you). Inside the unit, you'll find fresh new floors & paint, an updated kitchen & bath that bring the modern vibes. The kitchen's got it all, gorgeous wood cabinets, sleek stone counters, and shiny stainless-steel appliances that are just waiting for your next dinner party. The living room features a wood-burning fireplace for chill nights in, plus big east-facing windows that flood the space with morning light. Slide open the doors to your private balcony and soak in sweeping downtown views. Yes, they're as good as they sound. There's also a dining area with a built-in office nook and a spacious closet, making work-from-home life that much easier. The sky-lit bathroom features elegant stone counters. And yep, there's in-unit laundry with external venting, deeded parking and deeded storage for all your gear. Outside, the building offers two shared outdoor spaces, one w/a dog run for your furry BFF, and another for entertaining.  Low HOA & a friendly, self-managed HOA, this home is the full San Francisco package
